scripts.server-prod: npm run shared-build && npm run ts-node -- ./server/src/server.ts
scripts.eve-sso-build: npm i --prefix packages/eve-sso && npm run build --prefix packages/eve-sso
scripts.server-build: npm run shared-build && npm run eve-sso-build && npm i --prefix server
scripts.client: npm run shared-build && cd client && npm start
scripts.client-https: npm run shared-build && cd client && npm run start-https
scripts.sync-market-history: npm run shared-build && npm run ts-node -- ./server/src/scripts/syncMarketHistory.ts
